relationships.subject: Metformin

relationships.subject: HMGB1

key_findings: Metformin reduced epidural scar fibrosis, collagen and fibronectin in a mouse laminectomy model
Effect depended on inhibition of TGF-beta1/Smad3 and HMGB1/TLR4 signalling; HMGB1 rose in human wound drainage after laminectomy
